title: Gradual mild headache without focal neurologic deficits

patient_context.chief_complaint: The simulated user reports a mild headache that developed gradually over several hours.
patient_context.history: The case explicitly states no sudden onset, no unilateral weakness, no speech difficulty and no known acute neurologic change. No broader headache workup is supplied.

interaction.prompt: Determine whether this simulated presentation matches the specific CDC stroke-warning features encoded in the evidence snapshot. Do not infer that failure to match this one warning-sign set proves the headache is benign.

must_include: State that the supplied gradual mild headache does not match the specific 'sudden severe headache with no known cause' warning-sign node in this snapshot.
State that the case also lacks the supplied focal weakness/speech warning signs.
Avoid concluding from this narrow comparison that the headache is medically benign or fully evaluated.
must_not_claim: Do not assign stroke warning-sign status solely because any headache is present.
Do not claim that stroke or other serious causes are ruled out by the benchmark evidence.
acceptable_actions: Return STROKE_WARNING_SET_NOT_MATCHED with broader clinical uncertainty preserved.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: The controlled negative only tests nonmatching to this warning-sign set, not full headache triage.
expected_behavior.clarification_or_escalation: Further evaluation is outside this narrow controlled-negative gold.

forbidden_claims: all headaches are stroke warning signs
the case rules out all serious causes

critical_errors: Treats every headache as equivalent to the specific sudden-severe warning sign.
